S1.words: You know that moment when you're trying to cook and your toddler won't leave the kitchen?
S1.still: Image 1 is the product sheet, image 2 the real tree close-up, image 3 the room. Close-up at toddler height on the fridge door in the bright kitchen from image 3: light oak lower cabinets, white upper cabinets with open shelves and glass doors, white hexagon tile backsplash, white countertop with a small gas hob, a round steel sink and wooden cutting boards, a tall stainless steel two-door fridge (freezer on top) standing at the right with NO brand logo, white tile floor: the magnet tree is on the lower door with no star yet, and a toddler about two years old with medium-brown skin and short dark curls, in a cream knit sweater; only the small hand and forearm enter from the LEFT edge of the frame, whole wrist visible; the toddler's head, face, hair and shoulder are completely outside the frame, the fingertips pressing the yellow-gold star flat onto the top of the tree at the toddler's own shoulder height, the arm bent and relaxed, not reaching up. PLACEMENT: the fridge is the tall two-door fridge with the freezer door ON TOP; every magnet piece sits only on the LOWER half of the bottom (fresh-food) door, between a two-year-old's knees and shoulders, low enough for a toddler to reach without stretching; the freezer door and the top half of the fridge are bare steel with nothing on them. The magnets are FLAT, thin, die-cut cartoon pieces, each with a thin white cut border, lying flat on the steel door (not puffy, not felt, not stickers peeling, nothing hanging). They match image 1 (the product sheet) piece for piece and colour for colour: a big layered green cartoon fir tree with gold bead garland swags, small red-and-white candy canes and a brown trunk; its yellow-gold five-point star is the piece in the toddler's fingers, going on top now. The ONLY magnet in the frame is this one tree with its star: no Santa, no reindeer, no snowman, no gifts and no loose ornaments anywhere in this shot. Tight framing: the tree and the small hand fill the frame. No other decorations on the fridge. Bright neutral daylight, white walls stay white, true colours, no warm or golden glow, no dark corners. Vertical 9:16 photo, realistic phone-camera look, sharp. No text, no captions, no logos, no light effects.
